subject: [hw] DONE V16 rev 2
body:
Rev 2: test coverage only plus one form llvm-mc needs a second feature run for; implementation unchanged since rev 1 except nothing (F13 was already in rev 1).

Last lines of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v16/run_tests.sh:
    V16 checks 3284963
    N2TEST V16 PASS 3284963/3284963
    V16 checks 3284963
    N2TEST V16 PASS 3284963/3284963
(ASan+UBSan -O1 then plain -O2, ~6 s, artifacts only under /tmp/n2hw-v16.)

What changed since rev 1 (all in emu/test_v16):
- PLDW is now exercised in all its forms.  llvm-mc only emits it with the MP extensions feature, so run_tests.sh does a second llvm-mc run with `+mp` (same triple, one extra feature; V12 does the same for its A32 PLDW cases) and the 7 pldw cases are preload no-op checks.  It matters: `pldw` appears in the census (1) and in libvcodecdrv.so at 0xf9c10 = f8b0 fff4.
- Added the missing register-offset shift variants (LDR lsl#1, STR lsl#0, LDRH lsl#1/lsl#2, LDRSB lsl#0, LDRSH lsl#0), STR/LDR pc through the register form, and LDM/STMDB with LR in the list.
- STATUS.md (both copies) refreshed with the new count and the PLDW note.

Not done (unchanged, details in dsh-state/workers/V16/STATUS.md): T01 differential harness not green for V16 yet (kernels are in emu/test_v16/k_v16_mem.c and posted; the thumb configs currently fail for nearly every kernel including other packages, e.g. a 16-bit 0xb320 CBZ stop in V14s class); no phone run; no arm64 iOS build check; deliberate UNDEF list unchanged (LDM/STM empty/SP list, Rt/Rt2 = 15 in the dual/exclusive forms, TBB Rm = 15, byte/halfword store of pc, ops 6/7/14/15, 0xF9C/D, register Rm = 15, every coprocessor form except MRC p15,c13,c0,3, B<c>.W with cond 111x, 16-bit words).

Still available for hw-r1/hw-r2 findings and for the T01 re-run.
